'''2003 Chandrila State Championship David Destefanis LS Massassi Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David Destefanis]] at [[2003 Chandrila State Championship]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by David "Lirkas 'DDM'" Destefanis (2003-06-10).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=29193 Chandrila State 1st place LIGHT (a.ka. Broken Advance v.1.5)]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20061106121413/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=29193&PHPSESSID=29818f8b6da266174ddd746571e9b090 Internet Archive]</ref>
